agent_id.description: The agent_id of a service returned by a prior search_agents call.

title.description: Short title for the task (max 200 chars).

description.description: A one-to-two-sentence brief of the task for the agent (max 8192 chars).

slot_bindings.description: Which of the user's connections fills which of the agent's roles: { slot key: connection_id }. Only for roles a prior needs_connector result listed in unfilled_slots with proposals; omit otherwise.

attachment_ids.description: Ids of files to put ON the job so the agent sees them with the brief: the ids a chat message lists after `[attachments]`, or ones upload_attachment returned — at most 5; more is refused, ask the user which to keep. Omit when there is nothing to attach.
